terminals.name: RAIZ
terminals.description: Terminal na raiz do projeto API Comparator

terminals.name: 🐘 Backend Run
terminals.description: Inicia a API PHP com o servidor embutido (php -S)

terminals.name: 🔴 Kill Port 4200
terminals.description: Mata processos usando a porta 4200 (frontend Angular)
terminals.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4200 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -gt 0 } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

terminals.name: 🔴 Kill Port 8080
terminals.description: Mata processos usando a porta 8080 (API PHP)
terminals.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -gt 0 } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
